title: Hiring artist for 24 Twitch subscriber badges
content:
I’m slightly scared to post this because I know I’m about to get flooded 😭 but I’m looking for an artist to create 24 custom Twitch subscriber badges.

Looking for clean illustrated portraits that stay readable at tiny sizes. No kawaii/chibi/anime style, no oversized eyes, no overly chunky retro pixel art. Absolutely no AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork.

Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfAmvZg3MKQ0iYQOX16xW0PM5hd8aLwV20Oq-v9vNprEo85sw/viewform?usp=send_form
